tables.note: Same cells, levels and random structure as Table T3. Wire reliance is the share of a cell's coded foreign stories that credit AP, AFP or Reuters (credits only; no text-reuse rule, X4), so b is the change in following from a cell with no wire credits to one with wire credits on every foreign story. The confirmatory model carries no correspondent-presence term because V9 fell below the stability floor (X12); the first falsifier therefore reads the tier gap net of wire reliance alone, with correspondent presence inside the remainder. The falsifier read-out compares the upper bound of the net tier gap's 95% CI with half the H1 estimate from Table T3: the non-wire channels lose support when the bound lies below it and the H1 estimate is positive. The exploratory model adds V9 and stands outside the Holm family. Holm-adjusted decisions are in Table T6.
